title: Sir Mashalot: Mind-Blowing SIX Song Country Mashup
summary: Sir Mashalot blends six formulaic pop country songs into one seamless mashup using Pro Tools. It shows how similar the songs' chords and structure are.
why: Cited as a demonstration of how samey pop music is, in threads about chord progressions and homogeneous music.

quote.text: This brilliant mashup of 6 different formulaic pop country songs would imply that there is a very low bar for some music listeners.
